_meta.about: Batch 012: Indian fintech, insurtech, capital-markets, SaaS, AI and analytics companies in the v2 format, without figures. Leaders checked on the web in Oct 2026; entries marked 'not re-checked' could not be verified.
_meta.review: All entries unreviewed until the founder approves them.

companies.name: Moneyview

parts.SELLS: Moneyview is an app that gives instant personal loans to salaried and self-employed Indians, many of whom banks find hard to assess. It also offers credit tracking, savings and other money tools. The Bengaluru company listed on the NSE and BSE in October 2026.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest and processing fees on loans, some made from its own NBFC books and many made with partner banks and NBFCs, where it shares the income. Personal loans to mid-income borrowers are the core of the business.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger digital personal-loan apps and one of the few consumer lending fintechs that was profitable before listing. It serves borrowers across big cities and smaller towns.
parts.RIVALS: Kissht, Fibe, KreditBee, Navi and MoneyTap in app-based loans, plus the instant-loan offers of banks such as HDFC Bank and NBFCs such as Bajaj Finance.
parts.WATCH: Life as a newly listed company, how the RBI's digital lending rules and limits on unsecured credit shape growth, and how well borrowers keep repaying as it lends to more people.

quiz.prompt: What does Moneyview mainly offer through its app?
When did Moneyview list on the NSE and BSE?
Which of these is a rival app-based lender to Moneyview?

companies.note_30w: Moneyview is a Bengaluru app lender giving instant personal loans to salaried Indians, earning interest and fees. It listed in October 2026; watch credit quality and RBI rules.

companies.name: slice Small Finance Bank

parts.SELLS: slice began as a credit-card-style app for young Indians and became a bank after merging with North East Small Finance Bank in 2024. Today slice Small Finance Bank offers savings accounts, UPI payments, loans and a UPI-linked credit product in one app.
parts.EARNS: Like any bank it earns the gap between what it pays on deposits and what it charges on loans, plus fees. Its app-first, low-branch model is meant to keep costs low while it gathers deposits nationwide.
parts.SIZE: A small bank by Indian standards, but the only Indian fintech that bought a bank and is now run by its founder. That makes it a closely watched test of whether an app-first bank can scale.
parts.RIVALS: Small finance banks such as AU and Equitas, digital-savvy large banks like Kotak Mahindra Bank and HDFC Bank, and fintech apps such as Jupiter, CRED and Paytm that chase the same young users.
parts.WATCH: Founder Rajan Bajaj took over as MD and CEO in February 2026 with RBI approval. Watch how fast it grows deposits, keeps loan quality in check and meets RBI rules for small finance banks.

quiz.prompt: How did slice become a bank?
options: It won a new universal bank licence
It merged with North East Small Finance Bank
It merged with Paytm Payments Bank

quiz.prompt: How does slice mainly make money now?
options: The gap between loan interest and deposit costs

quiz.prompt: Who became MD and CEO of slice Small Finance Bank in February 2026?

companies.note_30w: slice turned from a credit app into a small finance bank after merging with North East Small Finance Bank. Founder Rajan Bajaj now runs it as MD and CEO.

companies.name: Fibe (formerly EarlySalary)

parts.SELLS: Fibe, earlier called EarlySalary, gives young salaried Indians quick personal loans, salary advances and buy-now-pay-later style credit for things like education and healthcare. Its own NBFC, EarlySalary Services, and partner lenders fund the loans.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest and fees on small, short loans. Personal loans to salaried urban professionals bring in most of its income, and it also earns from tie-ups with employers and merchants.
parts.SIZE: One of India's better-known app-based lenders to salaried professionals and among the profitable players in the space, with a loan book that has grown quickly in recent years.
parts.RIVALS: App lenders Moneyview, Kissht, KreditBee, Navi and MoneyTap, along with the instant-loan products of banks and large NBFCs such as Bajaj Finance and Tata Capital.
parts.WATCH: SEBI cleared Fibe's IPO in 2026; watch whether and when it lists. Also watch RBI digital lending rules and how it keeps repayments healthy as it grows.

quiz.prompt: What was Fibe called earlier?
Who mainly borrows from Fibe?
What did SEBI clear for Fibe in 2026?

companies.note_30w: Fibe, formerly EarlySalary, is a Pune app lender giving salaried Indians quick personal loans through its own NBFC. SEBI cleared its IPO in 2026.

companies.name: Kissht (OnEMI Technology)

parts.SELLS: Kissht is a loan app that offers small personal loans and credit lines to Indians with thin credit histories, along with loans against property through its sister brand Ring. Its parent, OnEMI Technology Solutions, listed on the NSE and BSE in May 2026.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest and fees on loans made largely through its own NBFC, Si Creva Capital. Small-ticket personal loans to first-time and mass-market borrowers make up most of the business.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger consumer lending apps by number of borrowers, focused on smaller towns and first-time credit users, and among the few listed app-first lenders.
parts.RIVALS: App lenders Moneyview, Fibe, KreditBee, Navi and MoneyTap, and large NBFCs like Bajaj Finance and Shriram Finance that also lend to mass-market consumers.
parts.WATCH: How it uses IPO money to grow its NBFC, how RBI rules on unsecured lending and digital loans affect it, and whether borrowers keep repaying as loan books grow.

quiz.prompt: What is Kissht's parent company called?
Which NBFC makes most of Kissht's loans?
When did Kissht's parent list on the NSE and BSE?

companies.note_30w: Kissht gives small personal loans to first-time borrowers through its NBFC Si Creva. Its parent OnEMI listed in May 2026; watch loan quality and RBI rules.

companies.name: Open (Open Financial Technologies)

parts.SELLS: Open offers small businesses a digital current account with partner banks, bundled with invoicing, payment collection, payroll, expense cards and accounting tools. It also sells banking software to banks and an embedded finance platform, Zwitch, to other companies.
parts.EARNS: It earns subscription fees from businesses, a share of payment and card fees, and licence fees from banks using its software. Small and medium businesses are its main customers.
parts.SIZE: One of India's best-known neobanks for small businesses and among the early fintech unicorns in that niche, serving a large base of small firms and freelancers.
parts.RIVALS: RazorpayX and Jupiter in neobanking, banks' own business accounts such as Kotak Mahindra Bank and ICICI Bank, and accounting tools like Zoho Books and Tally that small firms already use.
parts.WATCH: Its push to profitability after narrowing losses, growth of its software sold to banks, and RBI rules on how fintechs and partner banks share customers and data.

quiz.prompt: What does Open mainly offer small businesses?
options: A digital current account with business tools

quiz.prompt: Which of these is Open's embedded finance platform?
Which accounting tool competes with Open's offering?

companies.note_30w: Open is a Bengaluru neobank for small businesses, bundling a partner-bank current account with invoicing, payroll and cards, and selling banking software to banks.

companies.name: Cashfree Payments

parts.SELLS: Cashfree Payments helps businesses collect money online and pay it out at scale: payment gateway, bulk payouts, vendor payments, cross-border collections and identity checks. Customers range from startups to large lenders and insurers.
parts.EARNS: It earns a small fee on each transaction it processes and on payouts. Payment collection for online businesses is its biggest line, while payouts and cross-border payments are growing fast.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading payment gateways and a major player in bulk payouts for lenders, insurers and gig platforms, backed by SBI and Y Combinator among others.
parts.RIVALS: Razorpay, PayU, Juspay, Paytm and PhonePe's payment gateway in India, plus global players such as Stripe and Adyen for businesses that sell across borders.
parts.WATCH: It has said it aims for full-year operating profit and is raising fresh funds for global expansion and AI tools; it has spoken of a possible IPO in the next few years.

quiz.prompt: What is Cashfree Payments best known for?
How does Cashfree mainly earn?
Which of these is a Cashfree rival?

companies.note_30w: Cashfree Payments runs a payment gateway and bulk payouts for Indian businesses, earning per-transaction fees. Razorpay and PayU are rivals; profitability and an IPO are next.

companies.name: PayU India

parts.SELLS: PayU India is one of the country's biggest online payment gateways, helping merchants accept cards, UPI, net banking and wallets. It also runs checkout tools and merchant credit. It is fully owned by the Dutch-listed tech group Prosus.
parts.EARNS: It earns a fee on each payment it processes for merchants. Payment processing is the bulk of revenue, and it has added lending products, with Prosus putting fresh capital into its credit arm.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest payment gateways by volume, serving big online merchants as well as many smaller businesses, and one of Prosus's most important Indian holdings.
parts.RIVALS: Razorpay, Cashfree and Juspay in online payments, Paytm and PhonePe in merchant payments, and Pine Labs in in-store and online checkout. Competition is mostly on fees and on how reliably payments go through.
parts.WATCH: Prosus has named PayU among its likely Indian listings, and PayU reported positive operating profit for the first time in its latest year. Watch IPO plans and RBI payment aggregator rules.

quiz.prompt: Which group fully owns PayU India?
What is PayU India's main source of revenue?
Which of these competes with PayU?

companies.note_30w: PayU India, owned by Prosus, is a major online payment gateway earning fees on merchant payments. It recently turned operating profitable and is a likely listing candidate.

companies.name: Juspay

parts.SELLS: Juspay builds the payment software behind many big apps and banks: a payment orchestration layer that routes payments across gateways, UPI technology for banks, and checkout tools. Large e-commerce and travel apps are among its merchants.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees based on payment volume routed through its platform and licence fees from banks using its UPI and card software. Merchant payment orchestration is its core business.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading payment infrastructure companies, its software sits behind payments in many large Indian apps. It became a unicorn after a January 2026 funding round led by WestBridge Capital.
parts.RIVALS: Razorpay, PayU and Cashfree in merchant payments in India, and global payment firms such as Stripe and Adyen as it expands into other countries. Some gateways are also its partners.
parts.WATCH: Its expansion outside India, growth of its open-source payment software, and how a now-profitable business uses fresh money from its 2026 funding round.

quiz.prompt: What does Juspay mainly provide?
Who led Juspay's 2026 funding round?
Which global firm competes with Juspay abroad?

companies.note_30w: Juspay builds payment orchestration and UPI software for large merchants and banks, earning volume-linked fees. It became a unicorn in 2026 and is expanding abroad.

companies.name: M2P Fintech

parts.SELLS: M2P Fintech provides the plumbing that lets companies launch financial products: prepaid and credit card issuing, lending software, core banking and payments, offered through APIs. Banks, NBFCs and fintechs are its customers.
parts.EARNS: It earns platform and usage fees from banks and fintechs that run cards, loans and accounts on its software. Card issuing and lending technology are its main lines.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading banking-as-a-service and embedded finance infrastructure firms, with bank and fintech customers across Asia, the Middle East and Africa.
parts.RIVALS: Zeta and Perfios in India, card and lending platforms abroad, and large core banking vendors such as Infosys Finacle and TCS BaNCS that sell to the same banks.
parts.WATCH: Its push into the Middle East and other markets, progress toward profitability after widening losses, and RBI rules on co-branded cards and fintech partnerships.

quiz.prompt: What does M2P Fintech provide?
options: API infrastructure for cards, loans and banking

quiz.prompt: Who are M2P's main customers?
Which of these competes with M2P?

companies.note_30w: M2P Fintech is a Chennai infrastructure firm letting banks and fintechs launch cards, loans and accounts via APIs, earning platform fees. Watch overseas expansion and losses.

companies.name: Perfios

parts.SELLS: Perfios sells software that banks and lenders use to check borrowers: analysing bank statements, tax and GST data, fraud checks and loan decisioning. Its group includes fraud specialist Clari5, collections platform CreditNirvana and health-claims firm IHX.
parts.EARNS: It earns subscription and per-use fees from banks, NBFCs, insurers and fintechs. Lending analytics for financial institutions is its core business, and fraud and collections tools add more.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest software providers to banks for credit decisions and a fintech SaaS unicorn, with customers among most large Indian lenders and a growing list abroad.
parts.RIVALS: Credit bureaus such as CRIF, Experian and TransUnion CIBIL, Indian fintechs FinBox and Signzy, and global lending software firms such as Nucleus Software and Temenos.
parts.WATCH: Former SBI digital head Nitin Chugh became MD and Group CEO in March 2026, with Sabyasachi Goswami running core Perfios. Watch its long-discussed IPO and global expansion.

quiz.prompt: What does Perfios mainly sell?
Which fraud-detection company is part of the Perfios group?
Who became Perfios's MD and Group CEO in March 2026?

companies.note_30w: Perfios sells credit-decision and fraud software to banks and lenders. Former SBI executive Nitin Chugh became group CEO in 2026; an IPO has long been discussed.

companies.name: Upstox

parts.SELLS: Upstox is a discount broker app for trading stocks, futures and options, and for buying mutual funds, IPOs and digital gold. It is backed by Tiger Global and once counted Ratan Tata among its early backers.
parts.EARNS: It earns flat brokerage fees on trades, especially futures and options, plus interest on margin funding and fees on other products. Active traders bring in most of its revenue.
parts.SIZE: One of India's top discount brokers by active clients, behind leaders Groww and Zerodha and close to Angel One. Its users are mostly young, mobile-first traders.
parts.RIVALS: Discount brokers Groww, Zerodha, Angel One and Dhan, and bank-owned brokers such as ICICI Securities, HDFC Securities and Kotak Securities. Most compete on low fees.
parts.WATCH: Reports in 2026 said it began early talks with bankers about an IPO. Watch SEBI rules on futures and options trading, which hit broker volumes, and its push into wealth products.

quiz.prompt: What does Upstox mainly offer?
Which customers bring Upstox most of its revenue?
Which of these is an Upstox rival?

companies.note_30w: Upstox is a Mumbai discount broker earning flat fees on stock and derivatives trades. It trails Groww and Zerodha and has reportedly begun IPO talks.

companies.name: INDmoney

parts.SELLS: INDmoney is a money app where users track all their finances and trade Indian and US stocks, mutual funds, fixed deposits and bonds. It is especially known for making US stock trading easy for Indians.
parts.EARNS: It earns brokerage and fees on Indian and US stock trades, currency conversion on US trades, and distribution income on deposits and bonds. US stocks are a distinctive earner.
parts.SIZE: One of the larger wealth and broking apps in India and among the most used platforms for Indians buying US stocks, backed by Tiger Global, Steadview and Dragoneer.
parts.RIVALS: Groww, Zerodha and Upstox in Indian stocks, Vested and others in US stocks, and Paytm Money and ET Money among mutual fund and wealth apps. It stands out mainly on US stocks.
parts.WATCH: Rules on Indians sending money abroad under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme, SEBI rules on derivatives trading, and its path to profit and a possible listing.

quiz.prompt: What is INDmoney especially known for?
options: Easy US stock trading for Indians

quiz.prompt: Which of these is an INDmoney rival for US stocks?
Who founded INDmoney?

companies.note_30w: INDmoney is a Gurugram money app for tracking finances and trading Indian and US stocks and funds. Founder Ashish Kashyap earlier co-founded PayU India.

companies.name: smallcase

parts.SELLS: smallcase lets people buy ready-made baskets of stocks and ETFs built around a theme or strategy, through their existing broker such as Zerodha, Groww or Upstox. It also offers mutual funds and loans against mutual funds.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees when users subscribe to paid portfolios from SEBI-registered managers, a share of broker fees, and income from its lending and fund products. Its technology is built into many brokers.
parts.SIZE: India's best-known platform for model stock portfolios. Its baskets are available inside most large brokers, which gives it reach far beyond its own app.
parts.RIVALS: Wright Research and other portfolio managers, PMS providers and mutual fund houses, and wealth apps such as INDmoney and Groww that offer their own curated picks.
parts.WATCH: SEBI rules for research analysts and portfolio managers, its growth in loans against mutual funds, and how swings in the stock market change how actively users trade.

quiz.prompt: What does smallcase offer?
How do users access smallcase portfolios?
Which rule-maker's policies for advisers matter most to smallcase?

companies.note_30w: smallcase sells ready-made stock and ETF baskets through brokers like Zerodha and Groww, earning subscription and platform fees. Watch SEBI rules for advisers.

companies.name: Scripbox

parts.SELLS: Scripbox is a wealth management firm that helps salaried and affluent Indians plan and manage savings through mutual funds, fixed income and advisory services, online and through relationship managers.
parts.EARNS: It earns trail commissions from fund houses on money it manages for clients and advisory fees from wealthier customers. Mutual fund distribution is its core earner.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized digital wealth manager and one of the earlier online mutual fund platforms in India, now focused more on affluent families than on small savers.
parts.RIVALS: Online platforms Groww, Paytm Money and ET Money, and wealth firms such as 360 ONE, Nuvama Wealth and private banking desks at large banks. Most compete for the same savers.
parts.WATCH: It bought the mutual fund distribution business of Bluechip Capital in 2026 and promoted a new chief product officer to push an AI-first product strategy.

quiz.prompt: What does Scripbox mainly do?
Which business did Scripbox acquire in 2026?
How does Scripbox mainly earn?

companies.note_30w: Scripbox is a Bengaluru wealth manager earning mutual fund commissions and advisory fees. It acquired Bluechip Capital's fund distribution business in 2026.

companies.name: InsuranceDekho

parts.SELLS: InsuranceDekho sells motor, health and life insurance from many insurers, mostly through a large network of agents and partners using its platform, as well as online. It completed a merger with RenewBuy, combining two big agent-led insurance distributors under the InsuranceDekho brand.
parts.EARNS: It earns commissions from insurers on policies sold. Motor insurance is its biggest line, with health and life insurance growing as agents sell more to the same customers.
parts.SIZE: After the RenewBuy merger, one of India's largest insurance distribution platforms, with agents and partners reaching almost every pin code in the country.
parts.RIVALS: PB Fintech's Policybazaar and PB Partners, Turtlemint, Acko's direct channels, and banks and agents who sell policies for large insurers such as ICICI Lombard and HDFC ERGO.
parts.WATCH: Integrating RenewBuy, reports of board disagreements with the founders that the company has denied, IRDAI rules on commissions, and its stated plan to go public.

quiz.prompt: Which company merged with InsuranceDekho?
What is InsuranceDekho's biggest line?
Which of these is an InsuranceDekho rival?

companies.note_30w: InsuranceDekho sells motor, health and life cover through agents and online, earning insurer commissions. Its merger with RenewBuy made it a major distributor.

companies.name: Turtlemint

parts.SELLS: Turtlemint is an insurance distribution platform that equips agents and advisers to compare and sell motor, health and life policies from many insurers. Turtlemint Fintech Solutions listed on the NSE and BSE in June 2026.
parts.EARNS: It earns commissions from insurers on policies sold through its agent network and partners. Motor insurance is its largest line, with health insurance growing.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger agent-led insurance distributors, with a wide network of advisers spread across smaller towns and cities where online buying is less common.
parts.RIVALS: InsuranceDekho (now merged with RenewBuy), PB Fintech's PB Partners, and the bank, agency and direct sales channels of insurers such as ICICI Lombard and Bajaj Allianz.
parts.WATCH: Its first year as a listed company after a weak market debut, IRDAI rules on insurer commissions, and competition with the merged InsuranceDekho-RenewBuy.

quiz.prompt: How does Turtlemint mainly sell insurance?
options: Through agents and advisers on its platform

quiz.prompt: When did Turtlemint list on the stock exchanges?
Which company is a Turtlemint rival?

companies.note_30w: Turtlemint gives insurance agents a platform to sell motor, health and life policies, earning commissions. It listed in June 2026; watch IRDAI commission rules.

companies.name: Ditto Insurance

parts.SELLS: Ditto helps people choose health and term life insurance through free, no-spam calls with advisers, and helps with claims later. It grew out of the team behind the Finshots newsletter, and Zerodha is its largest shareholder.
parts.EARNS: It earns commissions from insurers on health and term policies sold. It deliberately recommends only a short list of plans it rates well, betting on trust over volume.
parts.SIZE: A smaller but well-known advice-led insurance broker, popular with young urban buyers and Zerodha customers, to whom it provides insurance services. It is far smaller than Policybazaar.
parts.RIVALS: Policybazaar, InsuranceDekho, Turtlemint and Beshak among distributors, plus direct online sales by insurers such as HDFC Life, Niva Bupa and Star Health.
parts.WATCH: IRDAI rules on commissions, growth of its claims-help service, and how it scales advice without hard selling as it adds more advisers. Its link with Zerodha's large customer base is a key source of new users.

quiz.prompt: Which company is Ditto's largest shareholder?
Which products does Ditto mainly help people buy?
Which of these competes with Ditto?

companies.note_30w: Ditto is a Bengaluru insurance adviser backed by Zerodha, helping people pick health and term cover without spam calls, and earning insurer commissions.

companies.name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance

parts.SELLS: Niva Bupa is a standalone health insurer selling family health plans, senior-citizen cover and group policies for employers. Formerly Max Bupa, it is controlled by the UK's Bupa and listed on the NSE and BSE in November 2024.
parts.EARNS: It earns premiums and keeps what is left after paying claims and costs, plus income earned on the money it holds before claims are paid. Retail health policies are its main and most profitable line.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading standalone health insurers, second only to Star Health among companies that sell only health cover. It sells through agents, banks and online, and Bupa remains its controlling shareholder.
parts.RIVALS: Star Health, Care Health, Aditya Birla Health and ManipalCigna among standalone health insurers, plus the health lines of ICICI Lombard, HDFC ERGO and Go Digit.
parts.WATCH: IRDAI rules on claims and pricing, rising hospital costs, and the removal of GST on retail health premiums. Krishnan Ramachandran's term as MD and CEO runs to 2030.

quiz.prompt: What was Niva Bupa called earlier?
Which is Niva Bupa's main line?
Which standalone health insurer is Niva Bupa's biggest rival?

companies.note_30w: Niva Bupa, formerly Max Bupa, is a listed standalone health insurer controlled by Bupa. It earns premiums mainly from retail family health plans.

companies.name: Care Health Insurance

parts.SELLS: Care Health Insurance, formerly Religare Health Insurance, sells individual and family health plans, senior-citizen cover, group policies and travel insurance. It is a subsidiary of listed Religare Enterprises and is not itself listed.
parts.EARNS: It earns premiums and keeps what is left after claims and costs, plus income on its float. Retail health insurance sold through agents and banks is its main line.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger standalone health insurers, alongside Star Health and Niva Bupa, and the most valuable business inside its parent, Religare Enterprises.
parts.RIVALS: Star Health, Niva Bupa, Aditya Birla Health and ManipalCigna among standalone health insurers, and large general insurers like ICICI Lombard and HDFC ERGO.
parts.WATCH: Long-time insider Ajay Kumar Shah became MD and CEO in April 2026. Watch Religare's ownership under the Burman family, rising claims costs and IRDAI rules.

quiz.prompt: What was Care Health Insurance called earlier?
Which listed company is Care Health's parent?
Who became Care Health's MD and CEO in April 2026?

companies.note_30w: Care Health, formerly Religare Health, is a standalone health insurer owned by Religare Enterprises. Insider Ajay Kumar Shah became MD and CEO in 2026.

companies.name: Freshworks

parts.SELLS: Freshworks sells cloud software for customer service (Freshdesk), IT service management (Freshservice) and sales and marketing (Freshsales). Founded in Chennai in 2010, it listed on the US Nasdaq in 2021 and is not listed in India.
parts.EARNS: It earns recurring subscription fees from businesses, mostly small and mid-sized ones. Freshservice for IT teams is its fastest-growing product, and North America and Europe bring most revenue.
parts.SIZE: One of the best-known software companies founded in India and among the first Indian-founded SaaS firms to list on Nasdaq. It still has a large team in Chennai.
parts.RIVALS: Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Atlassian and HubSpot globally, and Zoho at home, which sells similar customer service and CRM tools. Most rivals are much larger US firms.
parts.WATCH: Its focus on IT service management and AI agents under CEO Dennis Woodside, cost cuts to protect margins, and competition from larger US software platforms.

quiz.prompt: Which Freshworks product is for customer service?
Where are Freshworks shares listed?
Which company is a major Freshworks rival in IT service management?

companies.note_30w: Freshworks, founded in Chennai and listed on Nasdaq, sells Freshdesk, Freshservice and Freshsales subscriptions. CEO Dennis Woodside is pushing IT service software and AI.

companies.name: Zoho

parts.SELLS: Zoho makes a large suite of business software: CRM, accounting (Zoho Books), email, office apps, HR and more, plus the Arattai messaging app. It is privately owned by its founders, has never raised outside funding and runs offices in rural Tamil Nadu.
parts.EARNS: It earns subscription fees from businesses worldwide, from tiny firms to large companies. Zoho CRM and its bundled Zoho One suite are its biggest products, and it is consistently profitable.
parts.SIZE: India's largest bootstrapped software company and one of the most profitable software firms founded in India, with customers in most countries. It employs a very large team in India.
parts.RIVALS: Salesforce, Microsoft, Google Workspace and HubSpot globally, and Freshworks and Tally in India for CRM and accounting software. It competes mainly on price and on offering a wide bundle of apps.
parts.WATCH: Co-founder Shailesh Kumar Davey took over as CEO, with Sridhar Vembu moving to chief scientist. Watch its chip and hardware plans and the growth of Arattai and Zoho Mail.

quiz.prompt: Which of these is a Zoho product?
How has Zoho funded its growth?
options: Its own profits, without outside funding

quiz.prompt: What role does Sridhar Vembu now hold at Zoho?

companies.note_30w: Zoho is a bootstrapped Chennai software maker selling CRM, accounting and office apps by subscription. Shailesh Davey is CEO; Sridhar Vembu is chief scientist.

companies.name: Chargebee

parts.SELLS: Chargebee sells subscription billing and revenue management software that helps online businesses handle recurring payments, invoices, pricing plans and revenue reporting. It was founded in Chennai and serves mainly software companies abroad.
parts.EARNS: It earns subscription fees that rise with the billing volume its customers run through it. Mid-sized software companies in the US and Europe are its core market.
parts.SIZE: One of the leading subscription billing platforms globally and one of the India-founded SaaS unicorns, with a large engineering team in its home city of Chennai.
parts.RIVALS: Stripe Billing, Zuora, Recurly, Paddle and Maxio, with Stripe the toughest because it bundles billing with payments. Most rivals are US-based, and some are larger.
parts.WATCH: Competition from Stripe's bundled billing, its use of AI in pricing and customer retention tools, and its stated aim of an eventual listing. It also faces pressure to keep costs in check.

quiz.prompt: What does Chargebee sell?
Who are Chargebee's core customers?
Which company is a Chargebee rival?

companies.note_30w: Chargebee, founded in Chennai, sells subscription billing software to software companies abroad, earning usage-linked subscriptions. Stripe Billing and Zuora are key rivals.

companies.name: Postman

parts.SELLS: Postman is a platform developers use to design, test, document and share APIs, the connectors that let software talk to each other. It started as a side project in Bengaluru and has a huge free user base.
parts.EARNS: It earns from paid team and enterprise plans that add collaboration, security and governance on top of the free tool. Engineering teams at large companies are its biggest payers.
parts.SIZE: The world's most widely used API platform and one of the most valuable India-founded software startups, with a large engineering team in Bengaluru.
parts.RIVALS: SmartBear's SwaggerHub, Kong and its Insomnia tool, Google's Apigee and Salesforce's MuleSoft in API design and management. Many large tech firms also build API tools of their own.
parts.WATCH: Its push into tools for AI agents and APIs used by AI models, converting free users to paid plans, and its path to a listing. Big companies' spending on developer tools matters too.

quiz.prompt: What do developers use Postman for?
How does Postman mainly earn?
Which of these is a Postman rival?

companies.note_30w: Postman is the most widely used platform for building and testing APIs, earning from paid team and enterprise plans on top of a free tool.

companies.name: BrowserStack

parts.SELLS: BrowserStack lets software teams test websites and mobile apps on real browsers and devices in the cloud, plus automated testing, accessibility checks and visual testing tools. It was founded in Mumbai in 2011.
parts.EARNS: It earns subscription fees from developers and testing teams, priced by product and usage. Large companies and fast-growing tech firms worldwide are its main customers, with most revenue from abroad.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's leading cloud testing platforms and among India's most valuable SaaS companies, profitable enough to fund an employee share buyback in 2026.
parts.RIVALS: Sauce Labs, LambdaTest (now TestMu AI), Perforce's Perfecto and AWS Device Farm in cloud testing. Sauce Labs is its oldest direct rival, while LambdaTest competes hard on price for smaller teams.
parts.WATCH: Its rollout of AI agents that write and run tests, global expansion, and competition from cheaper rivals that offer similar device clouds. Its large Mumbai team is central to that work.
